scientific_integrity: Exact finite-state generator proof and graph-Laplacian converse; numerical verification does not establish infinite families or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Single biased edge; equal symmetric background edge rates; finite simple connected graph and conserved nontrivial K; iff only within linear endpoint-tilt ansatz. Complete-graph limit has fixed positive rates and density tending to a number strictly between zero and one.
title: An exact locally driven exclusion steady state on true-twin graphs and hidden dissipation
